description: Unit tests for the ObserverManager class in the Orleans actor framework, including tests for concurrent modifications, notifications, subscription updates, expiration handling, and edge cases.

classes.name: ObserverManagerTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the ObserverManager class, verifying its behavior under various scenarios, such as concurrent access, modifications during notification, expiration handling, and collection management.

methods.name: CollectionModified
methods.description: Tests modifying the observer collection during notification, ensuring no exceptions and correct behavior.

methods.name: SubscribeDuringNotify_ObserversAreUpdatedImmediately
methods.description: Verifies that observers added during notification are immediately visible and whether they are notified appropriately.

methods.name: UnsubscribeDuringNotify_ObserversAreUpdatedImmediately
methods.description: Checks that observers unsubscribed during notification are immediately removed from the collection.

methods.name: SyncNotify_SubscribeAndUnsubscribe_WorksCorrectly
methods.description: Tests synchronous notification while subscribing and unsubscribing observers during the process.

methods.name: ExceptionInNotificationCallback_RemovesObserver
methods.description: Ensures that observers causing exceptions during notification are properly removed from the collection.

methods.name: SyncNotify_ExceptionInNotificationCallback_RemovesObserver
methods.description: Synchronous version of the above, verifying removal upon exception.

methods.name: ExpiredObservers_AreRemovedDuringNotify
methods.description: Tests that observers expired based on LastSeen time are removed during notification.

methods.name: ClearExpired_RemovesOnlyExpiredObservers
methods.description: Verifies that only expired observers are removed when ClearExpired is called.

methods.name: Clear_RemovesAllObservers
methods.description: Checks that Clear empties the collection of observers.

methods.name: CanModifyObserversConcurrently
methods.description: Tests concurrent subscribing and notification to ensure thread safety.

methods.name: PredicateFiltersObserversToNotify
methods.description: Verifies that custom predicates filter which observers get notified.

methods.name: AsyncPredicateFiltersObserversToNotify
methods.description: Verifies asynchronous predicate filtering during notification.

methods.name: EnumeratorWorksCorrectly
methods.description: Ensures the enumerator correctly iterates over observers.

methods.name: SubscribingExistingObserver_UpdatesLastSeenTime
methods.description: Verifies that resubscribing an existing observer updates its LastSeen timestamp.

methods.name: SubscribingExistingObserver_UpdatesObserverValue
methods.description: Checks that subscribing with the same ID updates the observer's stored value.

methods.name: SetExpirationDuration_AffectsExpiration
methods.description: Tests that changing the expiration duration affects observer expiration behavior.

methods.name: ClearDuringNotification_WorksCorrectly
methods.description: Ensures that clearing observers during notification does not cause issues.

methods.name: ModifyDuringEnumeration_WorksWithoutExceptions
methods.description: Verifies that modifying the collection during enumeration does not cause runtime exceptions and updates the collection state accordingly.
